live.claim: An authored encounter loss uses real combat, clears its actors and creates saved optional cross-town help.
live.proof: A hostile passport form defeated the staged 7-HP hero. The five forms disappeared, DECLARED LEGALLY FLATTENED displayed, and Chime-2 stood beside the respawn with an explicit free-help action.

live.claim: The loss offer survives an ordinary reload without hidden cost or pressure.
live.proof: After moving the QA-only staging marker outside the normalized encounter record, an ordinary reload retained ASK CHIME-2 FOR FREE CROSS-TOWN HELP. The visible bolt count remained 4 when help was accepted.

live.claim: Accepted help changes a readable encounter rule and persists through another loss.
live.proof: Applause Delay stated no reward penalty and free until victory; the assisted hearing visibly began at 1/5. A second real assisted loss retained the assist for the next retry.

live.claim: Same-frame projectile cleanup remains stable when damage ends the encounter.
live.proof: The first observation exposed an undefined projectile entry after encounter cleanup. A guarded reverse-loop cleanup was added, then the real assisted-loss path was repeated on a fresh tab and the browser log was exactly empty.

limitations: Repeated screenshots and bounded interaction prove visible states; no sub-frame timing is inferred.
The lunch recovery path was observed live; spotlight, getaway, co-op, win cleanup and save variants are covered structurally and deterministically.
